Method of Attack: Remote code execution via malicious ActiveX control embedded in Microsoft Office documents that host the MSHTML browser rendering engine
Attackers send specially-crafted Microsoft Office documents (.DOCX) that load Internet Explorer engine to render remote web page
Malware downloaded using specific ActiveX control in the web page
Discoverer: Rick Cole of Microsoft Security Intelligence
Attack Vector: Malicious Microsoft Office documents containing crafted ActiveX controls
Internet Explorer engine rendering remote web page
Indicators of Compromise: Suspicious Cpl File Execution alerts in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
